children: Kolkata: Microfinance company Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported a consolidated net profit of 18 crore for the second quarter of the fiscal, compared with 12 crore in the first quarter and a loss o 249 crore in the year-ago period.

The standalone net profit for the quarter under review, which reflects earnings from its microfinance operations, stood at 35 crore against a loss of 218 crore in the corresponding period last year. The consolidated pre-provision operating profit stood at 79 crore against a loss of 40 crore in the year-ago quarter.

title: Spandana Makes 18-cr Profit in Q2
